In order to guarantee message deliverability to three major US carriers (AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon), you'll need to register your business with The Campaign Registry (TCR).

The Campaign Registry, a third-party agency chosen by the major US cell carriers, collects a one-time fee of $19.50 to review your application in two phases. In the first review, The Campaign Registry completes an initial screen of your application. A third-party entity then does a second manual review of the information you supply in the registration form.
The Campaign Registry charges a monthly fee based on your use case to help you maintain good standing with the large US cell carriers.

Quo uses Internet to provide you with additional phone numbers on top of your existing devices. Download Quo on your mobile or use it on the web to make and receive calls and messages.
Quo works on mobile (iOS and Android) and desktop.
Does Quo use my phone plan’s minutes?
No. Quo uses your Internet connection - wifi or data. This allows you to use the service anywhere in the world.
How good is the call quality?
On a strong Internet connection you’ll have great call quality, even better than your carrier. We offer a free trial so you can try it and see for yourself.
What countries can I call and text?
Virtually any country in the world. Calling and texting US & Canadian numbers is included. For other countries, there is a per minute or per message rate based on the destination.
Can I use Quo with my team?
Yes. See pricing section above for details around features available to companies and teams.
Can I distinguish between business and personal calls?
Yes. Quo calls show up differently so you’ll be able to know when you get business calls.
What if I want to cancel my subscription?
Unlike our competitors, we won’t make you call us just to cancel your subscription. You can easily cancel your subscription at any time through the Quo app in just a few clicks.

If you cancel your subscription, it will remain fully active until the end of your current billing cycle. After that, all numbers will be saved for 60 days before being removed from your workspace. During this period, you and everyone in your workspace will no longer be able to make calls or messages, but you will still have access to existing conversations and workspace data in case you still need it.
What number will my customers see when I call?
Your Quo number. Your personal phone number stays private.
Can I use my Quo number to receive two factor authentication (2FA) codes?

In many cases, services that use 2-factor authentication (2FA) don't allow virtual phone numbers to be used during the registration/verification step. We recommend using your personal phone number for registering new accounts and Quo for all other purposes as you see fit.
